summary: Sensei Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting a board-reconstitution update ahead of its June 10, 2026 annual meeting. Director-designee Karen Vousden, Ph.D. delayed her appointment for personal reasons to 3Q/4Q 2026; Bob Holmen is to chair the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee effective June 12, 2026; the board will be set at five directors. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt forced management change is involved. The filing is a routine governance update with no special-situation transaction, and the board changes are voluntary, delayed appointments requiring stockholder approval.
